## Decisions

- Use the approved one-plan, one-session, one-task-worktree design with exactly two independent members and one integration session. Member implementation, correction and review requests may overlap; final review acceptance, validation, publication, archive and retirement are serialized.
- Implement this prerequisite serially through bounded parent-direct execution with an external execution ledger and independent review. Do not use the new parallel path to implement or accept itself. Preserve stopped-state gates and correction/review limits.
- Member sessions are user-started agents responsible for their own plans. Their sandbox workers keep existing restrictions. Add no terminal automation, credentials, model routing, external writes or leader election.
- Integration owns assembly, review acceptance, focused/authoritative validation, publication, lifecycle/index updates and retirement. Members report readiness until publication and retirement are verified.
- After A publishes, transfer B once and assemble at the current target in a fresh disposable checkout. Retain original B commits/handoff as provenance. Reserve the existing adjustment slot before substantive edits; mechanical replay creates no generation or review budget.
- Never import dirty/live work wholesale, rewrite commits or force-update refs. Preserve both requirements; incompatible requirements, scope/authority drift or exhausted transfer stop under existing owner/diagnosis rules.
- Review/validate the exact final diff at a frozen current base using admitted authority. Early formal reviews remain counted and cannot prove a changed target. Record diagnosis_required immediately after authoritative failure.
- Connect publication and retirement using verified original task tip, handoff, assembled diff and published descendant. Publish only the admitted product diff, serialize lifecycle commits afterwards, and retire only when every owned change is accounted for without dirty/unaccounted work. Never rewrite history merely to make obsolete member commits ancestors.
- Journal publication, group acceptance, lifecycle and retirement with bounded exact recovery. Preserve work on dirty targets or ambiguous state; failed B leaves accepted A and an incomplete group.
- Add a bounded read-only live-report verifier and a procedure in an isolated generated project with two useful bounded product implementation plans. Use two real operator-started agent sessions and one integration owner; prove overlapping implementation intervals, not just terminal lifetimes.
- Keep raw runtime/transcript evidence local and state unavailable sources. Bind the private report to installed revision, plans/group, distinct sessions, worktrees, diffs, review/validation evidence, publication order and retirement. Derive Git facts independently and reject missing, fake, altered or replayed evidence.
- Require PROJECT_AGENT_WORKFLOW_PARALLEL_LIVE_REPORT for this plan focused execution; tests/root-plan-lifecycle.sh invokes the verifier read-only. Ordinary CI fixtures never establish live acceptance. Bind the report digest to this plan completion evidence so unsetting the variable cannot waive the requirement.
- Do not check this plan until real-session acceptance passes. Unavailable runtime is a reported blocker with retained evidence, not permission to substitute mock tests. Introduce no new external automation.
- Inherit the reserved integration review: at most one formal member review precedes handoff. Review the final assembled target after its exact adversarial preflight using the remaining epoch slot. Never reset counts at transfer; if the final round leaves High/Medium findings, retain the result and take the existing stopped-owner path.
- Before implementation begins, initialize one private structured required-evidence record bound to this plan digest, its exact live acceptance digest and execution genesis; reserve the demonstration group identity there and later append its exact group and report digests. Bind the record identity into parent execution evidence. Missing, replaced or mismatched required records refuse finalization; no prose-keyword inference or environment flag can create or remove the obligation.
- The explicit report environment locates bytes for tests/root-plan-lifecycle.sh only. check-agent-completion.sh and every complete/finalize/publication path independently resolve the fixed required-evidence record and verified report digest through parent execution evidence; unsetting or redirecting the environment variable cannot waive this plan acceptance.
- Use runtime-provided external transcript bytes as primary evidence of distinct session identities and overlapping implementation tool events, with hook logs only as corroboration. Bind exact reviewed source digests and independently cross-check Git effects and runtime provenance. A self-authored summary or synthetic event fixture is not live proof; unavailable primary evidence leaves this plan incomplete.

## Tasks

- [x] Extend assembly for mode-discriminated handoffs and original-versus-final evidence.
- [ ] Bind inherited accounting and one-use transfer to exact final validation/publication.
- [ ] Connect checked publication, lifecycle and task retirement with full-change preservation and crash recovery.
- [ ] Implement bounded private-report verification and completion binding, rejecting fake sessions, missing evidence, non-overlap, stale revision or incomplete retirement.
- [ ] Add deterministic concurrent-member, conflict, target-race, dirty-source, replay, partial-failure and crash-boundary tests.
- [x] Align policies, inventory, generated smoke and actual Copier update fixtures.
- [ ] After static review/preflight run real member sessions in an isolated generated project, retain and independently verify evidence, then run focused checks with the required report and unchanged authoritative suites.
- [ ] Complete and publish only after independent review clears High/Medium findings and deterministic plus real-session acceptance pass.
- [x] Initialize and preserve the plan/acceptance-bound required-evidence record before implementation; test absent/replaced records, unset report environment and direct completion bypasses. Obtain primary transcript evidence for the real-session run or report the acceptance blocker.

## Validation Notes

The original execution remains `descope_required`; its execution gate refuses, and its descope gate refuses the changed source HEAD. Keep this plan `deferred`; do not replace its stopped ledger with an unbound epoch-zero run.
- The original private live-evidence record was found, not lost. Its self-digest matches the ledger's `required_evidence_reserved` event and its execution genesis matches the stopped run. It remains `reserved` with no report. The current verifier looks in a different repository-local location and no longer exposes the original reservation and binding commands. Preserve the original record; do not manufacture replacement historical evidence.
- Owner authorization: `approve_bounded_prerequisites`, accepting a separate bounded execution-resumption mechanism and verified transfer of the unchanged live requirement to plan 378, with stopped evidence and review accounting preserved. Implement `docs/plan/active/370-preserve-live-evidence-obligations-across-descope.md` first, then `docs/plan/backlog/371-resume-retained-work-after-verified-descope.md`. Both are mechanism-only prerequisites and may not apply their own new controls to this plan.

Then, under a separate task binding and exact owner authorization, verify the real obligation transfer, reconcile this plan's live-evidence instructions with plan 378, and admit retained execution through the checked path. The old ledger, its one recorded formal review, original required-evidence bytes and accepted acceptance partition remain evidence. No product implementation, validation acceptance or completion of this plan is claimed by authoring those prerequisites.
- The owner selected the bounded-descope normalization path after plan 367 confirmed that the legacy parent-direct lifecycle digest can be recovered without rewriting the stopped ledger. The recorded `plan-374-descope-001` partition is now materialized: acceptance item 3, digest `sha256:78d5a40ddf9da07975330961711334ee747e8bdf119961e1373ab28b57c42411`, moves unchanged to `docs/plan/backlog/378-verify-live-parallel-session-results.md`; items 1, 2, and 4 remain here. - Correction to the preceding note: an earlier report in this plan claimed that no formal review could be recorded at all because the runtime emits no reviewer evidence. That claim was wrong, and it generalized a property of the parent's runtime into a property of the repository. `plan-execution-state.py review` admits a reviewer against one `ReviewPacketStart` hook record or its normalized `review_packet_start` transcript equivalent, and `.project-agent-workflow/hooks/agent_log_event.py` produces exactly that record when a reviewer session's first submitted prompt declares `ReviewPacket: sha256:<digest>` at inherited turn zero, as `docs/agent/SPEC_AGENT_LOGGING.md` specifies. - Acceptance item 4 alignment: `references/orchestration.md` and its generated `SPEC_ORCHESTRATION.md` now state the integration path — mode-discriminated `assemble`, `publish` authenticating the integration session before it reads or moves the target, lease release, and integration-authorized member retirement — and no longer claim that registered checkouts wait for a later adapter. `SPEC_AGENT_LOGGING.md` and its generated counterpart gained a `Parallel Session Evidence` section binding each member transcript outside the demonstrated project by path and digest, requiring two distinct sessions and one tool record inside each declared implementation interval. `tests/validation_tools/generated.py` now checks root/generated parity, executability and inventory registration for `run-parallel-plans.py` and `verify-parallel-plan-sessions.py`, and checks that all three generated lifecycle gates name the verifier. `tests/smoke.sh` checks the same installation and text in a real generated project. A generated project has no canonical origin, so every plan failed its gates. `command_require` now treats an unresolvable identity as proof that no record can exist and reports no obligation, while a plan that still declares a contract refuses because the gate cannot key what it cannot verify. `test_an_originless_repository_stays_outside_enforcement` covers both directions. This matches the standing rule that a repository without a canonical `remote.origin.url` stays outside enforcement.
- Independent localization of the three open acceptance-item-2 findings, obtained read-only at commit 74ad0a0 and recorded here so the work is specified rather than rediscovered. (a) Retention: `verify_changes_retained` in `verify-parallel-plan-sessions.py` proves retention only by a name-only diff from the member base to the final tip, and `patch_digest` receives shape validation alone, so a later commit may overwrite a member's content or mode while the pathname still differs from its base. The retirement fix bound only retirement, not the report. The fix adds the handoff `result_tree` to each member report, regenerates the canonical binary diff from `base_commit` to that tree with the `tree_diff` flags, requires its digest to equal `patch_digest`, derives `changed_paths` from the same diff, and requires each changed path's tree entry at the published commit and the final tip to equal the result-tree entry in blob, mode, type and absence, path-scoped rather than whole-tree. (b) Publication recovery: `command_publish_recover` returns a no-op for any journal state other than `intended`, so a retirement that failed after `finalize_publication` rewrote the journal to `completed` can never be retried; an `intended` journal left by a crash after the authority recorded publication cannot replay because `publication_record` refuses a second publication; and recovery replays the original integration session identity and PID, which the strict incarnation check can no longer satisfy after that process exits. The fix records an authenticated publication intent bound to the journal, member, handoff, assembly, target ref, expected old commit and new commit before the target moves, adds an authority recovery operation that consumes only that exact intent, and distinguishes `intended`, `published`, `retired` and `aborted` journal phases so retirement is retried from `published` and idempotence is reachable only through the recorded intent. Ordinary duplicate publication stays refused. (c) Forced removal: `require_frozen_result` enumerates untracked paths with `--exclude-standard`, so ignored files are invisible and then destroyed by `worktree remove --force`; submodule dirt is not forced visible because the index and worktree comparisons omit `--ignore-submodules=none` and no initialized submodule is inspected; the check and the destructive command are separate operations; and the member binding records `stopped` immediately after proving its process live, so retirement never proves the member process exited. The fix requires the recorded member incarnation to have exited, enumerates ignored paths and inspects initialized submodules recursively, and removes the check-then-force race by moving the exact worktree to a private quarantine under the existing task-record lock and rechecking there before any removal, retaining it on every failed check.

- The owner authorized the bounded descope, and the classification is recorded as `plan-374-descope-001`; the ledger is now `descope_required` with reason `bounded_acceptance_reduction_required`. The partition keeps every source acceptance digest exactly once and in source order: retained are acceptance items 1, 2 and 4 (`sha256:fa8fd07e…`, `sha256:4f7453fc…`, `sha256:405a824f…`), and deferred is acceptance item 3, the live two-session demonstration (`sha256:78d5a40d…`), to `docs/plan/backlog/378-verify-live-parallel-session-results.md`. The classification could not reuse the review receipt, because the ledger refuses an independent-review receipt replay, so it is bound instead to a separate mode-0600 authorization record that names the review event, its consumed receipt digest, the recorded severities, the stopped reason and the owner's chosen option.
- The descope cannot be carried out, and the work stops here. `plan-execution-state.py check --operation descope_plan` is the only gate the stopped run leaves open, and it cannot pass for this run. It requires the named `--lifecycle-state` to resolve to the exact path bound at `init`, which is `plan-374/lifecycle.json`, and it requires that file's content digest to equal the last recorded lifecycle digest. Parent-direct execution never creates that file: it has no worker and therefore no candidate lifecycle record, and the preflight and review paths record a synthetic identity digest of `{implementation_mode, source_head, admitted_diff_digest}` in its place. Two facts combine here. First, `record` checks only that the supplied lifecycle digest equals the digest of the file named on the same command line; unlike `check`, it never verifies that the file is the bound lifecycle path. That gap let this classification bind the continuation registry's content digest, which no file at the bound path can carry.
